The text overlays change rapidly at the bottom of the screen to match her words.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to criticize the societal double standards and victim-blaming often directed at women in sexual harassment cases (the Me Too movement). It uses a structured argument to expose how perpetrators often face minimal long-term consequences while victims suffer systemic exclusion, ultimately expressing a hope for a genuine shift in social culture.
